english: Carry on with the party. Carefully.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Os seguimos en la pantalla grande.
english: You're on the big screen down here.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Copiado. Eso ha sonado muy heroico.
english: Copied. That sounded very heroic.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: La cafetería os dedica una canción.
english: The cafeteria dedicates a song to you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Si necesitáis algo, estamos aquí. Comiendo.
english: If you need anything, we're here. Eating.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Hola, nave! Solo llamábamos para decir hola.
english: Hello, ship! Just calling to say hello.

speaker: mission_control
english: Hello, {vessel}! Just saying hi.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aquí Control. Os echamos de menos. Un poco.
english: Control here. We miss you. A little.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Control a nave. Las plantas del despacho siguen vivas.
english: Control to ship. The office plants are still alive.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Informe del tiempo: soleado aquí, espacio ahí.
english: Weather report: sunny here, space up there.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Atención, nave: hoy es martes. Por si acaso.
english: Attention, ship: today is Tuesday. Just in case.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Novedades del centro: alguien ha roto la fotocopiadora. Otra vez.
english: News from the center: someone broke the copier. Again.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aquí abajo hemos puesto vuestra foto en la pared.
english: We put your photo on the wall down here.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Seguimos aquí, por si os sentís solos.
english: We're still here, in case you feel lonely.

speaker: mission_control
english: We're still here, {vessel}.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El becario ha preguntado si podéis traer una piedra.
english: The intern asked if you can bring back a rock.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, el asiento está un poco frío.
english: Control, the seat is a bit cold.

speaker: mission_control
english: It'll warm up soon. Very soon.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, how long now?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Poco. No te vayas al baño.
english: Not long. Don't go to the bathroom.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, has anyone checked the bolts?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Todos. Dos veces. El becario, tres.
english: All of them. Twice. The intern, three times.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: That worries me more.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, can I change seats?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No. Todos los asientos son iguales.
english: No. All the seats are the same.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: El de la ventana parece mejor.
english: The window one looks better.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Equipo, último aviso: ¿alguien necesita ir al baño?
english: Team, last call: does anyone need the bathroom?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Now that you mention it...

speaker: mission_control
english: Too late.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, aquí huele a pintura fresca.
english: Control, it smells like fresh paint in here.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Es pintura fresca. La pusimos esta mañana.
english: It is fresh paint. We put it on this morning.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he hecho una lista de lo que quiero ver.
english: Control, I made a list of what I want to see.

speaker: mission_control
english: What's on the list?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Everything.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El público está contando con vosotros. Literalmente. Ya cuentan hacia atrás.
english: The crowd is counting on you. Literally. They're already counting down.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Hello, crowd!

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, does the rocket have reverse?

speaker: mission_control
english: No.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Okay. Just asking.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: I'm ready. I think. Pretty sure.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Dicen que el primer viaje no se olvida.
english: They say you never forget your first trip.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Me he atado el cinturón dos veces. Por si acaso.
english: I buckled up twice. Just in case.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Los ingenieros os desean suerte. Mucha suerte.
english: The engineers wish you luck. Lots of luck.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: La prensa pregunta si estáis nerviosos. Les hemos dicho que no.
english: The press asks if you're nervous. We told them no.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, we go round and round.

speaker: mission_control
english: That's the idea.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ah. Pensaba que nos habíamos perdido.
english: Oh. I thought we were lost.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he visto el amanecer cuatro veces hoy.
english: Control, I saw the sunrise four times today.

speaker: mission_control
english: Show-off.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿desde aquí se ve mi casa?
english: Control, can you see my house from here?

speaker: mission_control
english: If you squint, yes.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: I see it! I think.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, aquí arriba no hay arriba.
english: Control, there's no up up here.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ni abajo. Por eso os mareáis.
english: Or down. That's why you get dizzy.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, hemos dejado de caer. ¿O seguimos?
english: Control, did we stop falling? Or are we still?

speaker: mission_control
english: Still falling. Sideways.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: How elegant.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Os vemos pasar por encima. Os estamos saludando.
english: We see you pass overhead. We're waving.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: We saw you! Well, no! But hello!

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: La órbita es como un columpio que no para.
english: Orbit is like a swing that never stops.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Una vuelta más y me sé el camino de memoria.
english: One more lap and I'll know the way by heart.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Órbita estable. Ahora sí podéis comer.
english: Stable orbit. Now you may eat.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, we made it! Now what?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ahora disfrutad. Y no os comáis las piedras.
english: Now enjoy it. And don't eat the rocks.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Disfrutad de {here}. Y no os comáis las piedras.
english: Enjoy {here}. No eating the rocks.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, el suelo es muy suelo.
english: Control, the ground is very ground.

speaker: mission_control
english: Great scientific observation.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he dejado una huella preciosa.
english: Control, I left a beautiful footprint.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, perfect footprint on {here}.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hazle una foto. Para el museo.
english: Take a photo. For the museum.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, there's nobody here.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, {here} is empty.

speaker: mission_control
english: Now there's you.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: That's nice.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, can we live here?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, could we live on {here}?

speaker: mission_control
english: Fill in the form first.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bienvenidos al suelo. Por favor, no pisoteéis la ciencia.
english: Welcome to the ground. Please don't trample the science.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Bienvenidos a {here}. Cuidado con la ciencia.
english: Welcome to {here}. Mind the science.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: It's so nice to stand still.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ya he recogido tres piedras. Una se parece a ti, Control.
english: I picked up three rocks. One looks like you, Control.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿puedo hacer una voltereta? Una pequeñita.
english: Control, can I do a flip? A tiny one.

speaker: mission_control
english: No.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Half of one?

speaker: mission_control
english: Not that either.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, esta nave vuela sola. Casi me ofende.
english: Control, this ship flies itself. I'm almost offended.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Pues déjala. Así no tocas nada.
english: Then let it. That way you touch nothing.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿me dais nota de ese último giro?
english: Control, can you score that last turn?

speaker: mission_control
english: A seven. For style.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Only a seven?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: He aparcado esta nave mejor que mi coche.
english: I parked this ship better than my car.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, I fixed a thing.

speaker: mission_control
english: Was it broken?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Not anymore.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eso no responde a la pregunta.
english: That doesn't answer the question.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, I have two bolts left over.

speaker: mission_control
english: From where?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: That's the big question.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he mejorado la cafetera con cinta.
english: Control, I upgraded the coffee machine with tape.

speaker: mission_control
english: Does it work?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: It makes coffee. And a noise.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Si algo se rompe, tengo cinta. Mucha cinta.
english: If something breaks, I have tape. Lots of tape.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he medido el silencio. Es muy silencioso.
english: Control, I measured the silence. It's very silent.

speaker: mission_control
english: We'll note that. Big discovery.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, I filled another notebook.

speaker: mission_control
english: With data?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: De datos. Y de dibujos de nubes.
english: With data. And drawings of clouds.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Todo es ciencia si lo miras de cerca.
english: Everything is science if you look closely.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, does this include breakfast?

speaker: mission_control
english: There are pouches.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: I'll leave a review.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿dónde está la tienda de recuerdos?
english: Control, where's the gift shop?

speaker: mission_control
english: Down here. When you get back.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he hecho cien fotos. Todas de mi cara.
english: Control, I took a hundred photos. All of my face.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Haz una de la ventana. Por variar.
english: Take one of the window. For a change.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Es el mejor viaje de mi vida. Bueno, el único.
english: Best trip of my life. Well, the only one.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, is the Mun made of cheese?

speaker: mission_control
english: No.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Sure? It smells funny.

speaker: mission_control
english: That's the ship.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he encontrado el botón de pausa.
english: Control, I found the pause button.

speaker: mission_control
english: There is no pause button.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Then what did I press?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿por qué el sol no se apaga por la noche?
english: Control, why doesn't the sun turn off at night?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Te lo explicamos cuando vuelvas. Con dibujos.
english: We'll explain when you're back. With pictures.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, esto está demasiado tranquilo. Me gusta el riesgo.
english: Control, this is too quiet. I like danger.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aquí no. Aquí nos gusta tranquilo.
english: Not here. Here we like quiet.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, sin problemas. Nunca hay problemas.
english: Control, no problems. There are never problems.

speaker: mission_control
english: You always say that.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: And I'm always right.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, is that noise normal?

speaker: mission_control
english: What noise?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Mine. I'm shaking.

speaker: mission_control
english: Breathe. Everything's fine.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿podéis decirme otra vez que todo va bien?
english: Control, can you tell me again that everything's fine?

speaker: mission_control
english: Everything's fine.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Gracias. Otra vez dentro de un minuto.
english: Thanks. Again in a minute, please.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, en mis tiempos los cohetes eran de madera.
english: Control, in my day rockets were made of wood.

speaker: mission_control
english: That's not true.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Well, cardboard.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he visto muchas vistas. Esta sigue siendo la mejor.
english: Control, I've seen a lot of views. This one is still the best.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Nos alegra oír eso de ti.
english: We're glad to hear that from you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Nave, ¿alguien ha cogido el bolígrafo del director?
english: Ship, did someone take the director's pen?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: It's here. It floats very well.

speaker: mission_control
english: He wants it back.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: He can come and get it.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, can you put me through to the cafeteria?

speaker: mission_control
english: This isn't a switchboard.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: I wanted to order a pizza.

speaker: mission_control
english: Team, we're sending you a joke. Ready?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Ready!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Qué hace un cohete en el sofá?
english: What does a rocket do on the sofa?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: What?

speaker: mission_control
english: Takes off for a nap. Sorry.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he intentado beber agua y me ha atacado.
english: Control, I tried to drink water and it attacked me.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Las burbujas de agua son traicioneras.
english: Water bubbles are treacherous.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿los planetas tienen nombre o se lo ponemos nosotros?
english: Control, do planets have names or do we name them?

speaker: mission_control
english: They already have names.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Shame. I had a great one.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Os informamos de que el becario ha ascendido.
english: We're informing you that the intern got promoted.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: To what?

speaker: mission_control
english: Head intern.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿cuántos botones hay en este panel?
english: Control, how many buttons are on this panel?

speaker: mission_control
english: Forty-two.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: I count forty-three.

speaker: mission_control
english: Don't press that one.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he soñado que me quedaba sin galletas.
english: Control, I dreamt I ran out of cookies.

speaker: mission_control
english: It was a dream. There are plenty left.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: How many?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No te lo vamos a decir.
english: We're not telling you.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, who decides the menu?

speaker: mission_control
english: A computer.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: I thought so.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Nave, ¿podéis repetir eso más despacio? El becario toma notas.
english: Ship, can you repeat that slower? The intern is taking notes.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Everything. Is. Fine.

speaker: mission_control
english: Thanks. He spelled it wrong.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, are you doing anything fun down there?

speaker: mission_control
english: We watch screens.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: And what's on the screens?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vosotros. Sois lo mejor de la tele.
english: You. You're the best thing on TV.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, how many people are listening to us?

speaker: mission_control
english: Right now, everyone.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Hola a todos. Me peiné para esto.
english: Hello everyone. I combed my hair for this.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, alguien ha dibujado una cara en la ventana.
english: Control, someone drew a face on the window.

speaker: mission_control
english: Is it smiling?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Yes.

speaker: mission_control
english: Then leave it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El jefe de vuelo quiere saber quién se comió su yogur antes del lanzamiento.
english: The flight director wants to know who ate his yogurt before launch.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: No sé de qué me habla.
english: I don't know what he's talking about.

speaker: mission_control
english: You have yogurt in your mustache.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿podéis apagar el sol un rato? Quiero dormir.
english: Control, can you switch off the sun for a bit? I want to sleep.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo intentamos. No nos hace caso.
english: We tried. It doesn't listen.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he hablado con una planta del laboratorio.
english: Control, I talked to a plant in the lab.

speaker: mission_control
english: And what did it say?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Nothing. But it listened.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Pregunta del público: ¿dónde guardáis los calcetines?
english: Question from the public: where do you keep your socks?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Everywhere.

speaker: mission_control
english: Perfect answer.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, how long until snack time?

speaker: mission_control
english: You just ate.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Eso no responde a la pregunta.
english: That doesn't answer the question.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, I wrote a poem.

speaker: mission_control
english: Go ahead.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Espacio, espacio, qué grande eres. Fin.
english: Space, space, how big you are. The end.

speaker: mission_control
english: Beautiful. Short. Beautiful.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿podéis mandarme la receta de la sopa?
english: Control, can you send me the soup recipe?

speaker: mission_control
english: It's salty water.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Well, it's delicious.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Atención, nave: la cafetería ha cambiado de horario.
english: Attention, ship: the cafeteria changed its hours.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: That doesn't affect us.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo sabemos. Queríamos compartir el dolor.
english: We know. We wanted to share the pain.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, do we have permission to sing?

speaker: mission_control
english: Permission granted. Low volume.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: La la la!

speaker: mission_control
english: Lower.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he puesto mi foto en la pared de la nave.
english: Control, I put my photo on the ship's wall.

speaker: mission_control
english: Why?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: So I don't miss myself.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Nave, el director dice que sois un ejemplo para todos.
english: Ship, the director says you're an example for everyone.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: A good example?

speaker: mission_control
english: An example.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, are there birthdays in space?

speaker: mission_control
english: Of course. Whose is it?

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Nobody's. But I wanted cake.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, este viaje necesita más ventanas.
english: Control, this trip needs more windows.

speaker: mission_control
english: We'll tell the designers.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: And a sofa.

speaker: mission_control
english: Not that.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, if I sneeze, do we change course?

speaker: mission_control
english: A tiny bit. Don't do it.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Too late. Achoo!

speaker: mission_control
english: Correcting course.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El becario ha preguntado si el espacio huele a algo.
english: The intern asked if space smells like anything.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Like metal. And socks.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Le diremos solo lo del metal.
english: We'll only tell him the metal part.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, he aprendido a dar volteretas sin manos.
english: Control, I learned to do flips with no hands.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Muy bien. Ahora aprende a parar.
english: Very good. Now learn to stop.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, can you tell me a story?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Érase una vez un kerbal que no tocaba nada.
english: Once upon a time there was a kerbal who touched nothing.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: And what happened?

speaker: mission_control
english: Nothing. He was happy. The end.

speaker: mission_control
english: Woohoo! I mean... copy. Very good.

speaker: mission_control
english: So pretty! Sorry. Data looks correct.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aquí Control. Esperad, que se me ha caído el bocadillo.
english: Control here. Hold on, I dropped my sandwich.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Lo sabía! Sabía que funcionaría. Más o menos.
english: I knew it! I knew it would work. More or less.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Toda la sala está aplaudiendo. Uno llora un poco.
english: The whole room is clapping. One of them is crying a bit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Os mando un saludo. No, espera, ese era el botón del café.
english: Sending you a greeting. No, wait, that was the coffee button.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Control a nave. ¡Ay, perdón, me he sentado en el micro!
english: Control to ship. Oops, sorry, I sat on the mic!

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Bravo! El director ha hecho un bailecito.
english: Bravo! The director did a little dance.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido. ¿Ha sonado muy serio? Estoy practicando.
english: Copy. Did that sound very serious? I'm practicing.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hola, nave. Soy el del turno de noche. Me he traído galletas.
english: Hello, ship. I'm the night shift. I brought cookies.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Cambio de turno! Os paso con alguien más simpático.
english: Shift change! I'm handing you to someone nicer.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Atención. Ha entrado una mosca en la sala. Seguimos informando.
english: Attention. A fly got into the room. We'll keep you posted.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Nos hemos ganado una pizza! Gracias a vosotros.
english: We earned a pizza! Thanks to you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Uy, he leído la hoja al revés. Todo bien. Mejor que bien.
english: Oops, I read the sheet upside down. All good. Better than good.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, you sound happy today.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Hay tarta! Y vosotros vais genial. Pero sobre todo, hay tarta.
english: There's cake! And you're doing great. But mostly, there's cake.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿quién está en la radio hoy?
english: Control, who's on the radio today?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Yo. El de las gafas. El guapo.
english: Me. The one with glasses. The handsome one.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: We don't know who that is.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: Control, are you okay? We hear shouting.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¡Gritos de alegría! Ha ganado nuestro equipo.
english: Shouts of joy! Our team won.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: What team?
